questions.instruction: What do users complain about regarding File bloat, corruption, AUDIT/RECOVER habits in Civil 3D?
questions.expected: Severity high: 2025 thread: accidental paste of a corridor as a block grew a file from 20 MB to 1.6 GB; RegApps bloat (>100,000 REGAPPS seen; purge halved a 20k-regapp file); unexplained growth cured by AeccPurgeAcaNodObjects; data-shortcut surfaces default to saving a copy in the consuming drawing. DOT guides prescribe routine PURGE -> AUDIT -> RECOVER, deleting stale .dwl/.dwl2 lock files, RECOVERALL, WBLOCK rebuild; AUDIT itself can hang; crash mid-save truncates the DWG beyond repair (rely on .bak). Survey databases corrupt when copied to shares and lock out all other users while one edits. (Source: https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/civil-3d-forum/urgent-file-size-is-huge/td-p/13769483 ; https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/civil-3d-forum/civil-3d-2020-21-and-22-file-size-bloating-drawing-only-includes/td-p/11750362 ; https://c3dkb.dot.wi.gov/Content/c3d/fil-sftwr-mgt/fil-sftwr-mgt-fix-dmgd-crpt-dwgs.htm ; https://ftp.mdt.mt.gov/other/webdata/external/esdc/library/Support-Civil3DUserMaintenanceSupport.pdf ; https://forums.augi.com/showthread.php?176841-Unable-to-recover-drawing-quot-Drawing-file-is-not-valid-quot)

questions.instruction: What do users complain about regarding Collaboration: ACC/Autodesk Docs, Desktop Connector, Vault in Civil 3D?
questions.expected: Severity medium: Desktop Connector 16.x: stale locks after crash/shutdown, slow or stuck syncs, duplicates, files that 'keep locking themselves'; Autodesk documents cases where changes are 'not uploaded to Autodesk Docs and the data is lost'; partial syncs open older versions; 'write protected' errors in 2026. Collaboration for Civil 3D requires the Pro tier (now Forma Design Collaboration), and repeated renames (BIM 360 -> ACC -> Forma) make users wary. Vault threads report shared surfaces missing after check-in and slow check-in/out with bloated files. (Source: https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Locking-and-Syncing-issues-in-Desktop-Connector-v16-x.html ; https://www.autodesk.com/support/technical/article/caas/sfdcarticles/sfdcarticles/Losing-data-when-working-with-DWG-files-in-Desktop-Connector.html ; https://forums.autodesk.com/t5/civil-3d-forum/civil-3d-files-on-acc-keep-locking-themselves/td-p/12972908 ; https://www.manandmachine.co.uk/autodesk-bim-collaborate-vs-bim-collaborate-pro/)

questions.instruction: What do users complain about regarding CADCraft input model and UI vs AutoCAD habits in open-source CAD programs?
